builds.name: Reference: Mana burn zones
builds.goal: Reference for Teemo: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged attrition and trap controller who pressures attacks with blind, disengages with speed and denies paths with mushrooms. Separate poison attacks and finite mushroom zones. Blind mitigates eligible attacks, not every physical spell; mushroom refresh and on-hit repetition need real mechanics checks. Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks.
builds.summary: Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks.
testPlan: Kit question for Teemo: Separate poison attacks and finite mushroom zones. Blind mitigates eligible attacks, not every physical spell; mushroom refresh and on-hit repetition need real mechanics checks.

Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Burn refresh is not unlimited independent stacking; measure target contact and debuff ramp.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Burn refresh is not unlimited independent stacking; measure target contact and debuff ramp.
Full cost 15,650 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Blackfire Torch, then Liandry. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Bloodletter's Curse, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.

Teemo fires a dart, Blinding the target for [2 / 2.25 / 2.5 / 2.75 / 3] seconds and dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage.

If Teemo stands still for [1.5] seconds without being damaged, he becomes Invisible until he moves. While in a brush, he can maintain Invisibility while moving.

builds.name: Ambush hybrid poison
builds.summary: Use the five-second stealth-exit attack buff with E's inspected AD and AP terms.
builds.goal: Use the five-second stealth-exit attack buff with E's inspected AD and AP terms.
builds.hypothesis: E's initial on-hit and four-second poison include both AP and AD statFormula terms. Statikk supplies both stats, Nashor adds attack magic damage and Rageblade tests repeated initial on-hits. Passive grants a finite attack-speed burst after stealth and W maintains attack distance.
testPlan: Required state: Stealth achieved before opening; one target kept in range during the five-second buff.
Separate initial E damage from poison ticks under normal and phantom hits, then vary AD and AP independently.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Detection or early peel loses the attack-speed window and poison refresh wastes duration.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated attacks do not prove independent stacking four-second poison damage streams.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Statikk Shiv, Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Zhonya's Hourglass, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.

builds.goal: Use a preplaced trap to start sustained combat before a protected attack trade.
builds.hypothesis: R deals AP magic damage over four seconds and reveals enemies; Q blinds attacks and W's active keeps speed when hit. Liandry and Riftmaker test a burn-to-contact hand-off, while Cosmic responds to magic damage and Nashor rewards attacks during the blind window.

Record combat ramp at trap activation and total attacks landed during Q blind versus a Q-only opening.

Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Sweeping or bypassing traps prevents ramp and spell damage still threatens through blind.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Blind blocks ordinary attacks, not all incoming abilities or item damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
